company_notes:
Short summary: large NA critical-infra systems integrator. Primary constraint = full air-gapped/private deployment inside classified enclave. Key asks: 1) model artifact signing + on-site deterministic load (no external registry pull), 2) HSM-backed key wrap and local KMS integration, 3) STIG/SCAP checklist and attestation, 4) option to run without any outbound telemetry or require opt-in per environment. Quote from CISO: 'We cannot accept any black-box telemetry or third-party callbacks; installation must be verifiable, repeatable, and auditable.'

POC scope agreed (one rack, 4xH100 nodes, private control plane deployed in isolated VLAN):
- Deliverables: offline model bundle + signature, install runbook, acceptance tests (latency SLO 150ms p95 for short chat turns, throughput baseline 20 concurrent chat sessions with KV cache on), failover behavior for model fallback (local quantized variant) during degraded operations.
- Acceptance criteria: offline install completes without internet, audit logs show model load + key unwrap events, perf within 20% of benchmarks shown in workshop.

Notes on technical preferences and constraints (shorthand):
- Prefer open/quantized LLM families (Llama-derivative or Mistral variant). No outbound model telemetry allowed.
- FIPS/HSM integration mandatory for key material. Must support sealed model bundles signed by Redwood + customer CA.
- Network: strict egress blocked; update path via USB/secure couriers acceptable if checksums/signatures verifiable.
- Ops: platform console expected to run in a private control plane but operators want same UI/look+feel as hosted (for training). Offline UI bundle acceptable.

Risks / deal hurdles:
- Procurement window long due to classified hardware approvals (targeting FYQ3 2026).
- Legal: additional DPA annex required for classified data handling and longer retention controls.
- Implementation: need runbook for repeated installs (air-gapped DR) + test harness for periodic validation.

Immediate action items (AE/SE):
- Daniel/Priya: produce detailed offline install runbook draft by 2026-03-05.
- Infra team: confirm H100 pricing and lead times; evaluate A100 fallback plan.
- Security: assemble STIG checklist template + CA signing flow document; share with customer drive links above.
